$comment: Forecast cycle and lead time model. Subtler than it looks, so it is expressed once here and implemented once in backend/app/shared/timeutil.py. See DATA_SOURCES.md section 11.

history.$comment: Negative leads resolve backwards into past cycles rather than into a past forecast hour of the current cycle.

publishedLeads.$comment: A cycle publishes incrementally and may skip a grid point. Always read the actual published leads and snap to the nearest one rather than trusting the grid.

precipRate.$comment: Cumulative precipitation is differenced against the previous PUBLISHED lead, not the previous grid lead. The old system had two implementations of this and one of them could hit a null on a skipped lead.
